On my side, I'm sitting at $93 with dark blues already housed, and I'm eyeing whether to secure yellows via Marvin Gardens or push for more cash to keep building toward hotels on my dark blues, since that's my strongest asset. Giving p4 cash would actually hurt their building capacity even while completing their set, so I'm leaning toward countering with a cash request around $225.
